body:
## Summary

Fixes #1559 — adds regression tests that prevent the "AI completely broken" scenarios that occurred in PR #1464 from silently recurring.

### Root Cause Analysis

PR #1464 went through 7 rounds of fixes to the SEARCHING state AI. Three of those rounds reached "AI completely broken":

| Round | Root Cause | Symptom |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| Round 5 | `as Array[bool]` typed-cast crash (Godot 4.3 issue #72627) | Entire AI state machine crashes — enemy frozen |
| Round 6 | GDScript semicolon trap: `return true` ran **inside** the `for` loop body | Enemies declared "all cleared" after 1 inspected point, abandoned search immediately |
| Round 7 | Empty flags array fell through to `return true` | Infinite relocation loop — enemy jiggles/freezes, no waypoints visited |

Plus two related issues also covered:
- **Issue #1419**: Enemies that never left IDLE entered SEARCHING on teleport (only enemies with `_has_left_idle=true` should search)
- **Issue #921**: `_transition_to_searching` must NOT set `_has_left_idle=true` or the `SEARCH_MAX_DURATION` timeout becomes unreachable for patrol enemies

### New Files

**`tests/unit/test_ai_regression_1559.gd`** — 24 unit tests in 5 groups:

| Group | Tests | Bug Guarded |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | 8 | Round 6 — GDScript semicolon trap in inspection-cleared logic |
| 2 | 3 | Round 7 — empty array must return `false`, not `true` |
| 3 | 5 | Issue #1419 — `_has_left_idle` gate in `reset_memory()` |
| 4 | 4 | Zone key formula and search radius expansion bounds |
| 5 | 4 | Source-code structural guards (read `enemy.gd` directly) |

Group 5 tests are particularly powerful: they read the actual `enemy.gd` source and assert structural fix markers are present. If a future change removes the `_has_left_idle` guard or accidentally adds `_has_left_idle = true` back to `_transition_to_searching`, a test immediately fails with the issue number it protects.

**`docs/case-studies/issue-1559/README.md`** — Timeline and root-cause analysis for each "AI completely broken" incident.

## Test Plan

- [x] All 24 tests are pure logic tests (Groups 1–4) or source-reading tests (Group 5) — no scene/Node2D required
- [x] Group 5 source-reading tests verified against actual `enemy.gd`: all structural assertions confirmed present
- [x] Buggy implementation (`_all_inspection_points_cleared_buggy`) included to document the exact failure mode

AI was declared "completely broken" in PR #1464, plus two related issues:

- Group 1 (8 tests): Round 6 — GDScript semicolon trap in
  _all_inspection_points_cleared where `return true` ran inside the
  for-loop body, causing enemies to declare "all cleared" after 1 point
- Group 2 (3 tests): Round 7 — empty flags array falling through to
  `return true`, triggering an infinite relocation loop
- Group 3 (5 tests): Issue #1419 — idle-only enemies must not enter
  SEARCHING on teleport (gate on _has_left_idle in reset_memory)
- Group 4 (4 tests): Zone key formula and search radius expansion bounds
- Group 5 (4 tests): Source-code structural guards reading enemy.gd
  directly to assert fix markers are still present

Also adds docs/case-studies/issue-1559/README.md with timeline and
root-cause analysis for each "AI completely broken" incident.
